city_center.notes: Fargo sits on the Red River of the North in the exceptionally flat, fertile Red River Valley -- prime wheat, sugar-beet, sunflower, and potato country. Downtown Broadway with the historic Fargo Theatre marquee is the gathering point. sources: en.wikipedia.org Fargo, North Dakota; Red River Valley agriculture framing.

cultural_notes: Fargo sits in the Red River Valley, one of the flattest and most fertile farm regions in the US -- wheat, sugar beets, sunflowers, and potatoes define the surrounding plains (source: Red River Valley agriculture framing, publicly documented)

Fargo is a refugee-resettlement city with New American communities (Somali, Bhutanese-Nepali, Kurdish) adding to a Scandinavian and German-Russian heritage base (source: general resettlement framing, publicly documented)
North Dakota is consistently one of the top US honey-producing states -- prairie honey is a genuine regional signature (source: USDA honey production framing, North Dakota a leading state)
Hornbacher's (a Fargo grocer), Hy-Vee, and Cash Wise are the regional grocers; the Red River Market is downtown Fargo's seasonal farmers market (source: chain regional footprint; redrivermarket.com)
